title: How I Upgraded My iPhone Memory 800% - in Shenzhen, China
summary: Scotty Allen of Strange Parts travels through Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei markets and learns to upgrade an iPhone 6s from 16GB to 128GB by swapping its flash chip. It is part 3 of his custom iPhone series and shows the difficulty of the hands-on repair work.
why: HN people recommend it for its vivid look at Shenzhen's repair culture and for the flash chip upgrade, and cite it in discussions of hardware modding.

quote.text: it gives such a cool sense of Shenzhen as a place to make and modify things
